title: 赫卡里姆·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 四蹄马身保留半人马比例，带角头盔与青绿色铠甲细节相互呼应。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Hecarim is an armored spectral centaur with a dark metal humanoid upper torso, equine body, four strong hooves, a horned helmet, and flowing teal spirit accents. Preserve the integrated half-human half-horse anatomy without skeletal horror or exposed remains. Armor fully covers the upper body, and his long polearm rests vertically beside him with its butt grounded, not lowered for a charge.
art_direction.scene: A composed near-profile study with a gentle head turn, signature forms stacked into a tall diagonal, luminous rim and airy negative space. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: iron, restrained teal, slate violet, pale amber; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
